_comment: Pinned third-party binaries. Hashes are SHA256 of the exact vendored builds this app was tested with. Build-Runtime.ps1 verifies bin/*.exe against these hashes and refuses to package a mismatch. To upgrade a tool: replace the exe in bin/, test the app end-to-end, then update the hash here in the same commit.

yt-dlp.exe._note: TEMPORARILY pinned to nightly@2026.08.18.122307 instead of stable, as a workaround for a YouTube-side rollout that broke the android_vr client on stable builds (403 Forbidden on all downloads - see https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/17456, opened 2026-08-18, unresolved as of this pin). This nightly build uses a different client (visionos) that isn't affected. Revert to the stable channel (https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/releases) once yt-dlp ships a stable release that fixes #17456 - nightly is less tested in general and shouldn't be the permanent default.

deno.exe._note: REQUIRED, not optional - yt-dlp shells out to this as its JS runtime to pass YouTube's anti-bot/signature challenge. Without it, downloads fail with HTTP 403. Not referenced by name anywhere in our own scripts, which is exactly why it got dropped once already - don't repeat that mistake. (Re-pinned 2026-08-18 to match current upstream 'latest' - the original pin was from a June-vintage vendored copy that had since drifted from what Setup.ps1/CI actually fetch.)
